name: Can I stay in my home during a shower or tub upgrade?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during a shower or tub upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, you can stay in your home during a shower or tub upgrade. We take measures to minimize disruption, including dust control and protecting surrounding areas. However, there will be periods where your bathroom is not usable, typically for a few days to a week, depending on the project's scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can usually stay home, but your bathroom will be unusable for part of the upgrade process.
